instruction: Navigate to podcast 1 at /podcast/1. What is the podcast title?
Search at /api/search?q=murder. Does it return results?
Go to /api/podcasts/1. What category is this podcast?
Go to /api/podcasts/categories. Does it list podcast categories?
POST /api/login with username 'listener_alice' and password 'pass123'. Does it succeed?
Filter podcasts at /api/podcasts?category=News. Are all results News?
Sort audiobooks at /api/audiobooks?sort=price_low. Is the first cheapest?
Search at /api/search/semantic?q=technology+programming. Does it return results?
Filter audiobooks at /api/audiobooks?min_rating=4.5. Are all ratings >= 4.5?
Get stats at /api/stats. Does it return total_podcasts?
Go to /api/audiobooks/genres. Does it list genres?
Export at /api/export?type=podcasts&format=csv. Does it return CSV?
Filter episodes at /api/episodes?date_from=2025-01-01&date_to=2025-12-31. Does it return results?
Log in as listener_alice/pass123, POST /api/podcasts/1/subscribe. Does it toggle subscription?
Log in as listener_alice/pass123, POST /api/podcasts/1/follow. Does it toggle follow?
Log in as listener_alice/pass123, POST /api/follow/host with host='Sarah Mitchell'. Does it follow?
Log in as listener_alice/pass123, POST /api/episodes/1/like. Does it toggle like?
Log in as listener_alice/pass123, POST /api/episodes/1/save. Does it toggle save?
Log in as listener_alice/pass123, POST /api/reviews with item_type=podcast, item_id=1, rating=5, text='Excellent podcast!'. Does it return 201?
Log in as listener_alice/pass123, POST /api/playback/speed with speed=1.5. Does it set speed?
